text: DSH Session Pins 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端的会话整理插件。它通过公开的侧边栏底部操作槽加入固定会话入口，并在菜单中列出已固定的会话。用户可以固定当前有效会话、取消固定、查看会话并在工作区状态允许时重新打开；重复固定会把会话移到列表最前，列表最多保留 100 项。数据按版本化列表保存在当前浏览器的 localStorage，并在同源标签页间同步。适合希望快速回到常用 DSH 会话的 Web 用户；无需 API 密钥或外部账号。

DSH Session Pins adds a pinned-session menu to the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar. Pin eligible sessions, browse or unpin saved items, and reopen sessions when workspace state allows. Up to 100 entries persist in browser storage and sync across same-origin tabs. No API key is needed.
想给常用的 DSH 会话做个固定列表，之后能快速找回来。

Can I pin the current conversation and reopen it later in the web client?
DSH Session Pins 的功能「固定当前会话」：从侧边栏固定会话菜单的页脚选择固定当前会话，符合条件的非空主会话会加入列表；空白会话和子代理会话不可新固定。
DSH Session Pins 的功能「整理固定列表」：打开侧边栏菜单查看固定会话，列表按最近固定顺序显示；重新固定已有会话会将它移到最前，单项可取消固定。
DSH Session Pins 的功能「重新打开会话」：选择列表中的会话后进入详情菜单，工作区就绪且会话可用时可选择打开；归档或状态未就绪时显示提示。
DSH Session Pins 的功能「浏览器保存与标签页同步」：固定列表写入当前来源的 localStorage，重新载入后读取；同源页面通过 storage 事件更新列表，存储不可用时当前页仍可使用内存状态。
DSH Session Pins 的功能「适配侧边栏宽窄布局」：固定会话入口在展开侧栏显示名称和数量，在窄栏显示图标及辅助提示；打开菜单后可浏览列表、返回或取消固定。
DSH Session Pins 使用前须知：固定项保存在当前浏览器来源，不跨设备或不同来源同步；存储不可用时仅在当前页面保留。（见 src/client/pin-repository.ts:21）

@dsh-external/dsh-session-pins README · DSH Session Pins：The plugin answers
[DeepSeek Harness Discussion #63](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/63),
which asks to keep valuable sessions easy to reach. Harness does not expose a
public session-row action slot, and replacing the stock session browser would
couple a plugin to private UI source. Session Pins therefore contributes one
root-scoped action through the public `sidebar.footer.action` slot. It does not
patch or replace the host.

@dsh-external/dsh-session-pins README · Compatibility status：The automated suite includes an isolated, keyless rc.6 profile smoke: it
installs this repository through the published CLI, composes the plugin row,
boots on an ephemeral loopback port, reads the root boot manifest, and fetches
the package-name browser module route. Task 7's manual wide/rail visual
acceptance remains pending and is not claimed here.

@dsh-external/dsh-session-pins README · User experience：- **Wide sidebar:** the footer action shows a pin icon, **Pinned sessions**, and
  the current pin count.
- **Rail sidebar:** the same action is icon-only, with an accessible name and a
  delayed tooltip.
- Activating the action opens a menu above the footer. Selecting a root row
  opens a same-menu drill-down with **Open**, **Unpin**, and **Back** as
  applicable. An empty list has an explicit empty state.
- An ordinary current session can be pinned when it is non-blank and not from
  a subagent. The newest pin appears first; pinning an existing id moves it to
  the front without duplicating it. A pinned current session offers **Unpin
  current session**.
- A blank current session cannot be newly pinned. If a blank id is already
  stored, it remains removable and can be opened only while its non-subagent
  summary still resolves and workspace availability is actionable.
- A subagent current session cannot be newly pinned or opened by this plugin.
  A previously stored subagent id remains removable; a rejected open is
  contained and leaves the recovery actions usable.

@dsh-external/dsh-session-pins README · Browser-local persistence：Pins are stored in `localStorage` under `dsh.session-pins.v1` as a versioned,
ordered id list. Input is validated: malformed records fall back to empty,
non-string and blank ids are removed, duplicate ids keep their first
occurrence, and at most 100 pins are retained.

@dsh-external/dsh-session-pins README · Browser-local persistence：Persistence is browser-local. It does not sync across devices, browser
profiles, browsers, or different origins. Same-origin tabs reconcile
through browser `storage` events while the plugin is active; the tab that
writes a change updates itself directly because browsers do not send that
`storage` event back to the writing document. If `localStorage` is blocked or
throws, pins remain usable in memory for the current page but do not survive a
reload.

@dsh-external/dsh-session-pins README · Install after release：The GitHub repository and tag are created during the release step. Run these
commands only after the referenced release exists.

Install the `v0.1.0` Git tag into the stock web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:alooshxl/dsh-session-pins#v0.1.0
```

To upgrade to another Git tag, repeat `add` with that tag; do not use `update`
to select a Git ref. For example:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:alooshxl/dsh-session-pins#v0.1.1
```

@dsh-external/dsh-session-pins README · Install after release：For an immutable installation, replace the placeholder with the full
40-character commit SHA:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:alooshxl/dsh-session-pins#<40-character-commit-sha>
```

Remove the plugin:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @dsh-external/dsh-session-pins
```

Launch the stock web profile:

```sh
dsh web
```

The equivalent explicit launch is:

```sh
dsh --profile web
```

@dsh-external/dsh-session-pins README · Security and host boundaries：- No API key or other credential is required to pin, unpin, persist, or open a
  session.
- The package does not read credential files, ship temporary browser profiles,
  or include private Harness source.
- Product behavior stays in the browser client entry. The Node entry only
  enables package registration and browser-module discovery.
- Integration uses published Harness client services and the public
  `sidebar.footer.action` slot. There is no host patch, monkey patch, or
  compatibility layer.

@dsh-external/dsh-session-pins README · Local development：Use Node 22 and pnpm 11.7.0:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/alooshxl/dsh-session-pins.git
cd dsh-session-pins
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
```

@dsh-external/dsh-session-pins README · Local development：The frozen development graph allows lifecycle scripts only for the exact
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local@0.1.0-rc.6` and `node-pty@1.1.0` transitive
host dependencies required to boot the published rc.6 Web profile on Linux.
Every other discovered script is denied. These development-only host packages
are not part of the packed plugin or its installation contract.

The GNU Make checkpoint is:

```sh
make fmt && make test && make lint
```

On systems without GNU Make, run its exact commands:

@dsh-external/dsh-session-pins README · Local development：```sh
pnpm run format && pnpm run test && pnpm run lint
pnpm run typecheck
```

Run the complete release-oriented verification:

```sh
pnpm run build
pnpm run format:check
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm run verify:self-contained

`pnpm run verify:package` performs the local dry-run package inventory
validation through a compatible package-manager invocation.

The final `git status` command must print nothing: tracked and untracked
generated-artifact drift is blocking.
